title: Slow Magnetic Relaxation and Single Molecule Toroidal Behaviour in a Family of Heptanuclear {CrIIILnIII6} (Ln = Tb, Ho, and Er) Complexes

material_class.structural_family: heptanuclear {CrLn6} of two Ln3 triangles linked by octahedral CrIII

synthesis.procedure: Under aerobic conditions, Cr(NO3)3·9H2O (0.4 g, 1 mmol) and Tb(NO3)3·6H2O (0.22 g, 0.5 mmol) were dissolved in MeCN (20 mL). ortho-Toluic acid (0.14 g, 1.0 mmol) and triethylamine (0.55 mL, 4.0 mmol) were added to give a pale purple solution, which was stirred for 4 h. The solvent was removed to a purple oil, which was redissolved in MeOH/iPrOH (1:1) and left for slow evaporation. Pale purple crystals formed within 10–15 days.
synthesis.vessel_or_method: aerobic solution reaction followed by slow evaporation
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Solvent removed to a purple oil, redissolved in MeOH/iPrOH (1:1), and crystallized by slow evaporation.

properties.summary: Field-induced SMM: no zero-field out-of-phase ac signal, but frequency-dependent maxima below about 4 K in 3000 Oe with two processes (Ueff = 12.3 K, τ0 = 6.3×10−8 s for the thermally activated process; a second, nearly temperature-independent QTM process). Room-temperature χMT = 68.95 cm3 K mol−1 and M = 28 Nβ at 2 K and 5 T without saturation. μ-SQUID hysteresis opens below 0.03 K. Ab initio/POLY_ANISO analysis gives antiferromagnetic Cr–Tb and Tb–Tb coupling and a small exchange barrier of 0.65 cm−1, and predicts a con-rotating ferrotoroidal ground state.

properties.summary: Room-temperature χMT = 86.32 cm3 K mol−1 and M = 36 Nβ at 2 K and 5 T. No out-of-phase ac signal is observed in zero field or in a 3000 Oe bias field. μ-SQUID hysteresis is observed below 0.03 K. Calculations give ferromagnetic Ho–Ho coupling (Jtot = 0.6 cm−1) from a small anisotropy–vector angle (17.6°) and antiferromagnetic Cr–Ho coupling, with an exchange barrier of only 0.1 cm−1, and predict a con-rotating ferrotoroidal ground state.

properties.summary: Field-induced SMM: no zero-field χ″, but frequency-dependent maxima below about 4 K in 3000 Oe. Two relaxation processes are observed; the temperature-dependent process has Ueff = 4.5 K and τ0 = 9.1×10−8 s. Room-temperature χMT = 67.25 cm3 K mol−1 and M = 30 Nβ at 2 K and 5 T. No μ-SQUID hysteresis is observed. Exchange coupling is the strongest of the series and antiferromagnetic (Cr–Er Jtot = −1.2 cm−1; Er–Er Jtot = −0.85 cm−1). The calculated ground-state barrier is 0.4 cm−1, with a second excited-state barrier of 3.5 cm−1 (5.0 K). A local toroidal moment is not predicted.
